critique.evidence: Frame pacing is stable: tablet/mobile average about 16.67 ms with 16.8 ms worst frames and zero long-frame ratio; desktop has zero long frames but averages 19.31 ms with a 33.4 ms worst frame. However, the standard samples show 0 active animations and 0 changed elements at every viewport, so no interaction or transition quality is demonstrated. Reduced motion is visually static, but still reports 1 active animation on desktop and mobile, while 205–251 elements retain transitions.
critique.fix: Capture measured frames while triggering Atlas interactions such as tier/filter changes, stage navigation, and vector selection. Demonstrate intentional easing, continuity, and stable frame pacing, then make reduced-motion runs report zero active animations and disable nonessential transitions rather than applying them to nearly every sampled element.
